result:
The form now saves BMI as its own observation, and the server can judge that observation against reference ranges. Older encounters without a stored BMI still show a value, calculated in the browser. The change is commit `d4857fbf` (PR #3238, "Surface BMI reference ranges in the biometrics table"). I found no ticket key in its message, in the code, or in the commit search, so the ticket is unidentified.

**What the form stores**
- On create, the form saves a new obs with concept `bodyMassIndexUuid` (`1342`) whenever a BMI is computed. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx:205-222`
- On edit, it voids the previous BMI obs and saves a new one, but only when weight or height changed. The same file, lines 205-222.
- The concept is configurable through `bodyMassIndexUuid` in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/config-schema.ts:45-47`.
- The judgement against reference ranges happens on the server: the code comment says OpenMRS core only sets an interpretation when an `ObsReferenceRange` exists (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts:514-521`). I did not read the core implementation to confirm this.

**How older encounters still show a value**
- `useVitalsAndBiometrics` prefers the persisted BMI value. When there is none, it falls back to `calculateBodyMassIndex` from weight and height (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts:361-366`).
- That fallback value has no stored interpretation, so older rows will still show no low/high flag. That is my reading of the code, not something I tested.

**Other supporting pieces**
- The BMI column is wired to the concept so cells get an interpretation: `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/biometrics/biometrics-base.component.tsx:77`.
- The BMI concept is added to the fetched biometrics concepts and mapped to `bmi`: `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts:189` and `:289`.
- The `bmi` and `bmiRenderInterpretation` fields are typed in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/types.ts:116-117`.
